**🚨 BREAKING: 5V Allied Powers Disbanded by Slop Company**
@🚨 Breaking Pings 

**5V Allied Powers (5V)** has been disbanded by the **Slop Company** following the discovery of a Discord bot used to track Roblox players affiliated with other factions.

Evidence provided to BCBN shows the bot monitoring six accounts identified as members of The Inner Circle (TIC), displaying their activity status and game information.

According to the disbandment announcement, Slop Company has disbanded/banned 5V permanently and its owner from all factions. The owner has also been reported to Roblox and Discord over proven privacy violations.

**Following the announcement, all remaining members were instructed to leave the 5V Discord server immediately.**

📋 Sources & Information

**Primary Source:** Slop Company Staff
**Supporting Evidence:** Screenshot documenting the bot’s tracking activity
